concepts.definition: A stratum of the frame by journey margin: low , under 10 minutes (24 frame instances); median , 10 to under 30 minutes (38); high , 30 minutes or more, or unbounded (26).
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: One instance measured in one engine under the protocol: origin and destination typed verbatim from the census nodes' specs, depart-at set, and every itinerary the engine offers recorded with its rank, full route sequence, and arrival. The rate phase's workload is 64 captures.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The generalization phase's computation of the native journey for every instance: 15 significant nodes giving 210 directed pairs, at three departure slots (Thursday 12:45 PM, Thursday 5:15 PM, Saturday 12:45 PM) — 630 instances, computed from the timetable alone.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: One of 8 one-transfer optima matched to the two-transfer sample on margin band and departure slot, chosen by closeness of journey margin to the selected two-transfer band medians. The controls are a matched comparison set, not a probability sample of the census's 282 one-transfer optima.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: An absence flagged when the engine's best bus arrival is achieved by an itinerary using SMART routes no later than the native arrival; a flag stands when any itinerary achieving that best arrival uses SMART routes. A flagged absence is a coverage case — the engine answered from a different network — not an invisibility case; the primary rate counts it regardless, and the coverage-adjusted rate excludes it.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The departure specified for an engine query. The protocol sets it to the instance's census departure exactly (Thursday instances at the mapped same-weekday date recorded in §5); when an engine substitutes a different departure, the capture is flagged and not silently scored.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The range attached to θ wherever it is stated, propagated from the bands' Wilson 95% bounds under the study's design-based framing: 0.56–0.97 for Google, 0.44–0.94 for Moovit. The range is part of the claim — the record supports a rate in that span, not a precise point.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: An instance measured before the rate phase existed, by purposive selection: the Providence study instance and the demonstration instances D1–D8. Exhibits are reported separately, excluded from every pool, and never pooled into any rate.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The population the rate phase estimates over: the census's 88 two-transfer optima.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: Per engine, θ = Σ (N h / 88) · (x h / n h ) over the three bands, with frame counts N = (24, 38, 26): the bands' invisibility rates combined at the frame's band shares — the estimated proportion of the 88-instance frame that is sequence-invisible to that engine.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: One measurement unit of the census: a (departure slot, origin node, destination node) triple. The census holds 630 instances; the rate phase's frame, sample, and controls are all instances.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The maximum leg margin over an optimal journey's legs; unbounded if any leg is infeasible. It is the instance-level measure the rate phase stratifies on — a maximum-leg statistic, not a whole-journey margin (§6).
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: One route's ride within a journey, from boarding to alighting. A journey of one leg is direct; two legs make one transfer; three legs make two transfers.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: For a leg of the optimal journey: the best arrival with that leg's route removed from the timetable and the journey fully re-optimized, minus the optimal arrival. A margin of null — no journey exists without the route — is unbounded.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: A leg with a margin of 5 minutes or more, or with no journey existing without it (infeasible). The substitute in the margin test is the best routing the network offers without the leg, not a single named alternative.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: In a three-leg journey, the second leg — the one between the two transfers.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The journey the native planner returns for an instance: the earliest-arriving journey under the planner's own rules — at most 2 transfers, at most 30 minutes of cumulative walking, walk transfers within the feed's 400 m graph. "Optimal" throughout means planner-optimal in this sense.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The Live Transit app's own planner engine, computing journeys from the DDOT GTFS timetable (feed S1000182, scheduled times) alone. Every "native" figure in this study is its output; no external engine's output enters it (§7).
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: A capture flagged in its file as not final because a protocol condition — the departure time or date — was not met as specified. Its verdicts are not scored until a recapture resolves them.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: A capture run again under the protocol's exact conditions, replacing a provisional or unreadable original; the protocol allows one recapture per unreadable capture. The two provisional batches were resolved by exact-date recaptures (§5).
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: A journey written as its ordered routes: 10-3-8 is route 10, then route 3, then route 8. Sequence matching ignores walk legs and presentation; an itinerary containing SMART routes is a different sequence — recorded as offered in its own right, never as a match.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The 24 two-transfer instances selected for capture: 8 per band, allocated between the load-bearing-middle and non-load-bearing-middle cells in the full frame's proportions for that band (low 3/5, median 5/3, high 6/2), and taken at centered systematic ranks within each cell so the picks span the cell's margin range. The selection is deterministic, with one predeclared adjustment (the Saturday floor, §3) — a stratified selection with known frame weights, not a random draw.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The study's primary outcome, per instance and engine. An engine is scored offered when the native route sequence appears among its itineraries at the instance's matched departure, at any rank (for Moovit, at any display position across its sections); otherwise the native journey is invisible to that engine for that instance — recorded as not offered .
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: The status of a provisional capture once its recapture is final: the provisional file is retained and marked superseded, never edited into agreement, and no superseded verdict feeds any total.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit

concepts.definition: An instance whose native journey has exactly two transfers (three legs). The census's 88 two-transfer optima are the class this study measures.
concepts.definedInTitle: The Invisible Middle Leg — Live Transit Detroit
